context: A mom and son chat at dinner
purpose: Teach: おかず/歪み/ぶつかる/硬く/防ぎ/意地悪/ほどほど/足取り

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Eager, direct question pitched upward. Quick pace. The natural curiosity of a six-year-old who's been waiting. No pretense.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ハンバーグよ。お皿、歪みがあるから、丁寧に扱ってね。
lines.en: Hamburger. But that plate has a slight warp, so handle it gently, okay?
lines.style: Warm but matter-of-fact. The instruction delivered without fuss—a mother noting a practical concern while staying gentle. Even pace, steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 走り回って、机にぶつかること、多いから、気を付ける。
lines.en: I bump into the desk a lot when I'm running around, so I'll be careful.
lines.style: Sho's small, genuine voice—not defensive, just accounting for himself. Quiet recognition of his own patterns. Slight self-awareness underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Your shoulders aren't getting tense, are they?
lines.style: Gentle check-in. A slight shift toward concern—she's noticing something. Warm but observant, the way she attends to him. Soft questioning lilt.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、ストレッチで防ぎたい。
lines.en: Yeah—I want to keep them loose with stretches.
lines.style: Small, earnest voice. He's thought about this a bit. Not rehearsed, just his honest answer. A trace of focus underneath the lightness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達に意地悪、しないでね。
lines.en: And don't be unkind to your friends, all right?
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. A quiet directive that carries weight because she means it. No anger—just clarity. The pause before 'all right' expects acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、ほどほどに、ふざける。
lines.en: Yeah—I'll mess around with them, but not too much.
lines.style: Quick, small agreement. A hint of wry honesty—he understands the balance. His voice suggests he knows exactly what she means and accepts it without fuss.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんの足取り、玄関で聞こえてきたわ。
lines.en: I can hear your father's footsteps at the entrance now.
lines.style: Warm observation—she's noticing his arrival without fanfare. Gentle, almost intimate tone. The kind of moment that marks routine comfort. Quiet and content.
